description: Export EVERY lead matching a filter to a downloadable file and return { url, filename, format, count, bytes, truncated }. `url` is a signed link (valid 7 days) to a private file. Unlike export_leads (which pages 100 at a time), this pulls the whole filtered set server-side into one file. format: csv (default; flat lead columns + account_name + memory_count/documents_count, for spreadsheets) | json | jsonl (both full-fidelity: all columns + ai_memory[] + documents[] + nested contact/account). Same filters as list_leads. max_rows caps the export (default 5000, max 20000); truncated=true means the cap was hit — narrow the filter or raise max_rows for the rest.

custom.description: Filter on lead custom fields (list_custom_fields entity 'leads'): { key: value } — value = equals (multiselect: contains), array = any of (multiselect: contains all), null = empty. E.g. { "stufe": "A", "marken": ["KTM"] }.

include_account.description: Nest the lead's account in json/jsonl (default true)

include_contact.description: Nest the lead's contact in json/jsonl (default true)

min_score.description: Only export leads with at least this score (0-100)

no_campaign.description: Only leads not assigned to any campaign

stale_days.description: Only leads whose last activity is older than N days

name: export_leads_file
